propositions: The output_mode function blanket-forces PromptedOutput whenever thinking=True based on stale Anthropic 400 rationale (tool_choice x thinking), but measured testing shows native output with thinking succeeds on sonnet and haiku models.

The guard should conditionally allow NativeOutput when both native_structured_output and native_output_with_thinking capabilities are true and thinking is enabled, rather than forcing prompted mode universally.
A new native_output_with_thinking boolean field (default False) must be added to the capabilities model to safely gate this behavior change without affecting existing model records.

Tools combined with thinking and native structured output suppress tool calling, which is why the sole call site (structured_run.py:181) is the no-tools single-shot path and never used by the agentic runner.
